validation.name: Live dashboard accessibility structure smoke
validation.detail: Chrome AX and DOM inspection on a recorded battle found 23 named interactive controls, one h1 with no skipped heading level, no duplicate IDs, no images missing alt text and no horizontal overflow; this remains a local structure smoke, not WCAG or assistive-technology certification.

validation.name: Visual report disclosure
validation.detail: CLI --include-visuals and API includeVisuals=true explicitly embed verified archived desktop/phone PNGs; default reports omit captures, Rust report tests cover opt-in encoding and the 4 MiB bound, and the screenshot-required bundled demo asserts both default omission and six opt-in captures without provider requests. Embedded captures remain render artifacts, not visual-regression, accessibility, performance or growth results.

validation.name: Bundled visual regression smoke
validation.detail: The real bundled demo's three sealed variants match six checked-in SHA-256 PNG baselines at 1280x900 desktop and 390x844 phone; archive dimensions, digests and the no-provider boundary are verified locally. This is a pinned local renderer smoke, not cross-browser parity or assistive-technology conformance.

validation.name: Bundled Firefox visual regression smoke
validation.detail: The real bundled demo's three sealed preview documents match six additional checked-in SHA-256 PNG baselines in Firefox 139.0.4 at 1280x900 desktop and 390x844 phone; viewport dimensions, overflow, named controls, heading-level continuity and the no-provider boundary are verified locally. Safari, other browser versions and assistive-technology conformance remain unverified.

validation.name: Bundled accessibility-tree and keyboard smoke
validation.detail: A real recorded bundled battle rendered in local Chromium; 19 DOM and AX interactive controls were named, one h1 had no skipped level, IDs/images/forms and overflow passed, and 30 Tab events reached visible focus stops without invoking a provider. The optional --output JSON handoff records all role/name pairs and providerInvoked=false. This remains a local structure and keyboard smoke, not screen-reader, cross-browser or WCAG evidence.

validation.name: Windows GNU package smoke
validation.detail: The current source built x86_64-pc-windows-gnu with cargo-zigbuild and Zig; current-main packaging produced SHA-256 745d90bb9d51d70c535abd0e600421a95c39d81ac3bf0bc39834b3eff3d2eba7 and the offline archive verifier passed checksum, traversal/link and notice checks. The exact alpha.20 tag ZIP is attached to the public release; Windows runtime, MSVC packaging and signing remain unverified.

validation.name: Public release asset verification
validation.detail: The read-only scripts/test-release-assets.py check downloads all five alpha.20 archive/checksum pairs, matches GitHub asset digests and sidecars, and passes archive safety/notices verification; macOS arm64 runtime passes locally, macOS x86_64 passes under Rosetta, and Linux and Windows runtimes are skipped on the macOS host.

validation.name: Local installer template generation
validation.detail: cargo-dist generated the alpha.20 shell and PowerShell installer templates locally with no upload; sh -n and the PowerShell parser accepted both scripts. The shell installer also fetched the local aarch64-apple-darwin archive through a disposable HTTP server, verified its SHA-256 sidecar, installed growthlab and orx into an isolated prefix, and reported version 0.1.0-alpha.20 without editing the test profile. Other target installer/runtime execution remains unavailable.

validation.name: Installer target matrix alignment
validation.detail: The cargo-dist matrix now includes the published x86_64-pc-windows-gnu archive and leaves MSVC out until a Windows SDK runner can validate it. Regenerated shell and PowerShell templates select the GNU asset; mapping assertions, shell syntax, PowerShell parsing, SHA-256 sidecar verification and an isolated macOS shell-install smoke passed.

validation.name: Installer template mapping smoke
validation.detail: scripts/test-installer-templates.py --check-shell is versioned and checks that generated shell and PowerShell templates select growthlab-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu.zip for the GNU target; shell syntax and PowerShell parsing passed without network, upload or provider access.

validation.name: Public SEO discovery contract
validation.detail: The public home and documentation pages expose one canonical URL each, Open Graph and Twitter cards, and truthful SoftwareApplication structured data. Static robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt are present, list only the two indexable pages, and state the product's SEO focus and evidence limits without analytics or growth claims.

validation.name: Public SEO page self-audit
validation.detail: The real GrowthLab CLI audited site/index.html locally: the explainable SEO page-hygiene rubric scored 100/100, all four images had useful alt descriptions, and no recommendation remained. The separate quality score stayed 28/30 and the accessibility structure score 100/100; both remain estimates rather than performance or WCAG certification.

validation.name: Native harness boundary fixture
validation.detail: scripts/test-growth-native-fixture.py used a disposable fake Claude CLI with no provider credentials; the current binary created three isolated worktrees, accepted valid implementation JSON, ran observed checks and sealed three UNTESTED runs while the product HEAD, files and remotes stayed unchanged. This verifies the local harness boundary, not a real provider response.

validation.name: Translated macOS x86_64 source suite
validation.detail: The current source x86_64-apple-darwin release suite ran under Rosetta on macOS arm64: 964 passed, zero failed and two inherited ignored tests. The confinement profile now permits only the Apple Rosetta runtime directory read-only; this does not prove native Intel hardware or the separately attached alpha.20 archive beyond its version smoke.

release.platform: Source prerelease with a macOS arm64 runtime-validated CLI archive plus macOS x86_64, Linux musl, Linux arm64 and Windows GNU structure-verified CLI archives
release.limitation: The attached macOS arm64 CLI archive is runtime-validated on macOS arm64; the attached macOS x86_64 archive passes its version command under Rosetta on arm64, while the Linux musl, Linux arm64 and Windows GNU archives are structure-verified only. The current source x86_64-apple-darwin suite also passes under Rosetta, but native Intel hardware remains untested. Native Linux and Windows runtime proof, installers and signing remain pending. Provider adapters and native-agent verification remain pending.
